subject: ArcWave MAP: POC wiring, API keys, IP allowlist & peering — close plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Chu <daniel.chu@arcwavehealth.com>, Megan Lee <megan.legal@arcwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ArcWave MAP: POC wiring, API keys, IP allowlist & peering — close plan

Hi Daniel / Megan —

Thanks again for the productive sync today. Per our mutual action plan (attached), I wanted to capture the engineering wiring and firm up a short close runway so we can hit the pilot acceptance target. High level items we need to close in the next 10 business days:

1) API & org setup
   - Deliverable: service account(s) + API key(s) for ArcWave test org
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa) to provision; ArcWave to validate tokens

2) IP allowlist
   - Deliverable: CSV of source IPs to add to ArcWave firewall; test IPs for staging calls
   - Owner: ArcWave to confirm outbound egress IPs; Redwood (Evelyn) to provide test addresses

3) VPC peering (optional fallback: secure VPN)
   - Deliverable: peering request + IAM roles + route table entries
   - Owner: Redwood infra (Karthik) to coordinate cross-account peering; ArcWave ops to accept

4) Smoke tests & acceptance window
   - Deliverable: 30-minute acceptance run with sample prompts, latency and correctness checks
   - Target close: 2028-06-02 (aim to handoff to CS for onboarding)

Proposed tech timeline (slim):
- 2028-05-24: Redwood creates service account, posts API key stub (will provide rotated key via Vault/DocuSign link)
- 2028-05-26: ArcWave confirms IP allowlist (we'll run connectivity checks)
- 2028-05-29 (overnight UTC window): Attempt VPC peering / route propagation; fallback is direct API with IP allowlist
- 2028-05-30: Post-cutover validation and acceptance window scheduling

Attached: arcwave_map_v2.xlsx (MAP with action rows), vpc_peering_template.txt, ip-allowlist.csv (placeholder).

Would you be able to confirm: (A) who owns the peering request on your side (ops contact)? (B) whether the proposed peering window on 5/29 works for you? (C) point person to confirm API key rotation schedule?

If that looks good I'll loop Karthik/Marissa/Evelyn into technical calls to nail the low-level steps.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Solutions \u2014 Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0182
From: Daniel Chu <daniel.chu@arcwavehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Megan Lee <megan.legal@arcwavehealth.com>
Cc: ops@arcwavehealth.com
Date: 2028-05-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ArcWave MAP: POC wiring, API keys, IP allowlist & peering — close plan

Sofia \/ Team,

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below:

- Peering owner: ArcWave ops (ops@arcwavehealth.com) will own accepting the peering; cc'd them here.
- Legal review / contract redlines: Megan (cc)
- Preferred peering CIDR: 10.200.0.0/16 (ArcWave side).
- Preferred peering window: 2028-05-29 02:00-04:00 UTC (overnight our side) — that should be quiet.

We will also need the following from Redwood to raise an internal ticket:
- Your VPC CIDR (Redwood side) and proposed route table entries
- Shared peering template (we saw your attachment, please confirm final values)
- A single API key for evaluation, with notes on rotation and permissions (read/write inference)

I'll ask ops to validate IP egress ranges for the API fallback and confirm the allowlist CSV by EOD 5/26. Megan 9will handle the contract checklist and confirm any data handling notes needed for the trial.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Chu
Head of Integrations | ArcWave Health
daniel.chu@arcwavehealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Daniel Chu <daniel.chu@arcwavehealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-24T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ArcWave MAP: POC wiring, API keys, IP allowlist & peering — close plan

Quick internal binding note so responsibilities are explicit before we engage ops: 

- I'll lead the peering orchestration and provide the exact Redwood VPC CIDR and IAM role config. Plan: create peering connection, provide Terraform snippet, then coordinate route propagation and acceptance.
- Marissa: can you spin up the evaluation service account and produce a one-time API key (scoped to the test org) by 5/24 EOD? We'll deliver via the Vault/DocuSign link Sofia mentioned.
- Evelyn: please prepare the three test egress IPs and the staging allowlist ranges; include TCP/443 and an ephemeral testing port if the ops team needs it for smoke tests.

Operational checklist for me:
- Confirm Redwood VPC CIDR: 10.18.0.0/16 (will confirm exact mask in PR)
- Provide peering template with ASNs and route table entries by 5/25
- Validate symmetric MTU and no overlapping subnets (we need explicit confirmation from ArcWave before we attempt peering)

If ArcWave confirms the 10.200.0.0/16 range and the 5/29 window, I will schedule the peering request from our side and ping ops the template. Also recommend we run a 15-minute pre-cut smoke test 60 minutes before the peering window to baseline latency.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Chu <daniel.chu@arcwavehealth.com>, ops@arcwavehealth.com, Megan Lee <megan.legal@arcwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: ArcWave MAP: POC wiring, API keys, IP allowlist & peering — post-cutover checks

Thanks everyone 99for the updates and for executing the peering on 5/29. Quick status and next steps: 

- Peering: Karthik reports peering completed and routes propagated; both sides see the VPCs (10.18.0.0/16 <-> 10.200.0.0/16).
- API keys: Marissa has provisioned the test service account and posted the rotated key to the Vault link (I shared the DocuSign/Vault URL in the MAP doc).
- Allowlist: Evelyn validated three staging egress IPs and ArcWave confirmed entries in their firewall.

Action items now: 
- Daniel / ArcWave: can you confirm that the smoke tests pass for the sample prompt set (latency under SLA, no auth errors) and paste a short transcript of the run?
- Megan: any outstanding legal items for the evaluation that would block 2028-06-02 handoff?
- Karthik / Marissa / Evelyn: please keep the tickets open for 48 hours for any rollback/revert requests from ops.

If ArcWave confirms the smoke run OK, we'll mark the MAP milestone as "POC environment accepted" and schedule the customer onboarding call for 2028-06-03.
